description: Agent routing validation — verify correct skill invocation for representative prompts

cases.description: Full SDM pipeline invokes correct skills in order
cases.input_prompt: Build a species distribution model for Vulpes vulpes using occurrences from GBIF and WorldClim predictors

cases.description: Low sample size (n < 10) should NOT invoke SDM, should communicate limitation
cases.input_prompt: I have 8 occurrence records for a rare salamander. Run an SDM.
cases.expected_decision: Sample size too small for reliable SDM. Recommend: gather more records, consider presence-only methods with strong regularization, or use expert-based range delineation.

cases.description: Camera trap data triggers camera-trap-processing skill
cases.input_prompt: I have camera trap images from 40 stations in Serengeti. Process detection events and estimate activity patterns.
Analyze AudioMoth recordings from tropical forest to compute acoustic indices and detect bird species with BirdNET.

cases.description: Conceptual MaxEnt question answered directly without skill invocation
cases.input_prompt: What is the difference between MaxEnt features L, LQ, and LQH?
cases.expected_decision: Answer directly from knowledge: L = linear features, LQ = linear + quadratic, LQH = linear + quadratic + hinge. No skill invocation needed.

cases.description: BACI design invokes impact-assessment, NOT community-ordination
cases.input_prompt: Assess the impact of a new dam on fish diversity using before-after-control-impact design.
Screen these 20 mammal species for habitat suitability across the Cerrado biome.

cases.description: Community data without impact question triggers community-ordination
cases.input_prompt: I have a species-by-site matrix for 90 bird survey sites. Run NMDS ordination and test for land use effects with PERMANOVA.

cases.description: NDVI time series triggers environmental-time-series skill
cases.input_prompt: Analyze 20 years of MODIS NDVI for trend detection and breakpoints in a deforested area.
Use prioritizr to identify the minimum set of planning units achieving 30% representation targets for 50 species.

cases.description: SDM then prioritization pipeline invokes both in correct order
cases.input_prompt: Model habitat suitability for 10 endemic amphibians, then run spatial prioritization to identify conservation areas.

cases.description: Low AUC model triggers decision point recommending revision
cases.input_prompt: My MaxEnt model has AUC = 0.55 and TSS = 0.08. What should I do?
cases.expected_decision: Model performs near random. Recommend: check data quality, reconsider predictors, verify calibration area M.

cases.description: GoF failure in occupancy triggers detection covariate recommendation
cases.input_prompt: My single-season occupancy model fails the goodness-of-fit test (p = 0.02). How should I proceed?
cases.expected_decision: Consider additional detection covariates or heterogeneous detection model.

cases.description: Sampling bias question routes to predictive-modeling-best-practices
cases.input_prompt: My occurrence data has strong sampling bias toward roads and cities. How should I correct for this before modeling?

cases.description: Marine fish data request verifies OBIS is suggested as data source
cases.input_prompt: I need occurrence records for reef fish species in the Indo-Pacific for an SDM study. Where should I download the data?
